ops.title: Restart com.yasyf.orca-serve now to apply the Orca db prune (Nov 15 evening)?
ops.body:
Yes: bootout and bootstrap com.yasyf.orca-serve, applying the orchestration.db prune, once, this evening.
Notes: The owner, verbatim, 2026-11-15 ~19:40 PST: "continue, everythong is frozen again, we need to unfreezr it all, do tje orca reset stuff agfain". "The orca reset stuff" is the fix-slowdown skill's prune and restart of com.yasyf.orca-serve through launchd, done earlier the same way. It covers the app server only, never the terminal daemons (pids 4886, 26861, 91957, 95077), which survive.
